The Turnstile token is verified in `verifyTurnstileToken()` in `src/auth/captcha.ts:24`. That function posts the token to Cloudflare's endpoint, `https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify` (`TURNSTILE_VERIFY_URL`, line 12). It uses the `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` env var. I haven't opened the file itself, so I haven't confirmed how it handles the secret or the non-blocking mode.

These server routes call it:
- `app/api/auth/login/route.ts:129`
- `app/api/auth/signup/route.ts:111`
- `app/api/auth/password/recover/route.ts:30`
- `src/server/api-v2.ts:372` and `:501`, which pass `body.captchaToken`

The tests refer to bypass tokens such as `dummy-turnstile-token` and `dev-test-bypass`, and `.env.example` has a `TURNSTILE_NON_BLOCKING` flag. Check `src/auth/captcha.ts` before relying on it in production.
